headline: LiteLLM breach traced to a leaked master key; exploited VeloCloud and Collabora flaws due Oct 26; PHP2Shell attacks continue

bullets.text: New since the last SITREP: reporting says the LiteLLM compromise began with a leaked master key that let attackers steal GitHub tokens and hijack the release pipeline. Version 1.107.0 on PyPI and Docker shipped a credential stealer that ran through Python startup hooks.

CISA's KEV deadline for two actively exploited flaws is Oct 26: OS command injection in Collabora Online's built-in CODE server (CVE-2026-110447) and SQL injection in Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator (CVE-2026-114625), the third exploited VCO zero-day in four months.

PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619) allows unauthenticated code execution through PHP; fixes are in 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35. Exploit attempts hit millions of hosts, some deploying Mirai. A third bug, CVE-2026-115560, will not get an emergency fix.

Microsoft 365 accounts at 79 organizations were taken over with stolen sessions and no passwords. Separately, Microsoft ties the ConnectWise cloud-backup supply-chain attack, which reached over 2,250 Microsoft 365 tenants, to Storm-0940.

Railway says some customer environment-variable secrets were decrypted and is telling all users to rotate keys. Ruby fixed three regex engine bugs behind four critical GitLab RCE flaws, and Pillow has a FlashPix heap overflow allowing code execution from a crafted image (CVE-2026-112398).
Breaches confirmed: Quest Diagnostics patient personal and health data, 11.7 million CAPCOM ID accounts, and a firewall and VPN campaign that exposed over 70,000 credentials.

actions: Search lockfiles, images and CI caches for litellm 1.107.0. If it ever ran, treat the host as compromised and rotate every credential it could read.
Patch or take offline Collabora Online (CODE server) and Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator before Oct 26 and check both for signs of compromise.
Update PHP to 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 or 8.2.35, rebuild images that bundle PHP, and restart PHP-FPM or Apache.
Review Microsoft 365 sign-ins for session reuse, revoke suspicious sessions, and check ConnectWise cloud backup app consent.
If you deploy on Railway, rotate every secret stored there and revoke the old values at each provider.
Patch self-managed GitLab and update Ruby and Pillow in your apps and images.
